You will discard your hand, enemies will take their turn, you will draw [blue]5[/blue] cards, then it will be your turn again.
tip.END_TURN.title: End Turn {Hotkey:choose(None):| ({})}
tip.ENERGY.description: Energy is used to play cards from your [gold]Hand[/gold].
tip.ENERGY.title: Energy
tip.ENERGY_COUNT.description: Your current Energy ({energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}) count. Cards require {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} to play, indicated in the top left corner.
tip.ENERGY_COUNT.title: Energy
tip.EVOKE.description: Consume your rightmost Orb and use its Evoke effect.
tip.EVOKE.title: Evoke
tip.EXHAUST_PILE.description: Click to view cards Exhausted this combat.
tip.EXHAUST_PILE.title: Exhausted Cards {Hotkey:choose(None):| ({})}
tip.FATAL.description: Triggers whenever this card kills a non-minion enemy.
tip.FATAL.title: Fatal
tip.FLOOR.description: How far up you have climbed.
tip.FLOOR.title: Floor
tip.FORGE.description: The first time you [gold]Forge[/gold] each combat, add [gold]Sovereign Blade[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Adds additional damage to [gold]Sovereign Blade[/gold].
tip.FORGE.title: Forge
tip.HIT_POINTS.description: If you run out of HP, you die.
tip.HIT_POINTS.title: Hit Points (HP)
tip.LINKED_REWARDS.description: You can only select [blue]1[/blue] reward from this set.
tip.LINKED_REWARDS.title: Linked Rewards
tip.MAP.title: Map {Hotkey:choose(None):| ({})}
tip.MONEY_POUCH.description: How much Gold you have. Gold is the currency within the Spire.
tip.MONEY_POUCH.title: Gold
tip.NETWORK_PROBLEM_CLIENT.description:
Your connection with the host ([gold]{Player}[/gold]) is poor.
This could be a problem with your internet or theirs.
tip.NETWORK_PROBLEM_CLIENT.title: Poor Connection!
tip.NETWORK_PROBLEM_HOST.description:
Your connection with [gold]{Player}[/gold] is poor.
This could be a problem with your internet or theirs.
tip.NETWORK_PROBLEM_HOST.title: Poor Connection!
tip.POTION_SLOT.description: Use potions during combat to gain [green]bonuses[/green] or [red]hinder[/red] enemies.
tip.POTION_SLOT.title: Potion Slot
tip.REPLAY_DYNAMIC.description: Plays this card an additional {Times:plural:time|[blue]{}[/blue] times}.
tip.REPLAY_DYNAMIC.title: Replay
tip.REPLAY_STATIC.description: Plays this card an additional time.
tip.REPLAY_STATIC.title: Replay
tip.ROOM_ANCIENT.description:
Ancients reside in these rooms.

They grant incredible bonuses, treasures, and knowledge.
tip.ROOM_ANCIENT.title: Ancient
tip.ROOM_BOSS.description:
The deadliest foe in the area.

Defeating them will let you proceed to the next Act.
tip.ROOM_BOSS.title: Boss
tip.ROOM_ELITE.description:
Powerful foes are in these rooms.

Defeating them will reward you a [gold]Relic[/gold].
tip.ROOM_ELITE.title: Elite
tip.ROOM_ENEMY.description: Hostile enemies reside in these rooms.
tip.ROOM_ENEMY.title: Enemy
tip.ROOM_EVENT.description: Something unusual occurs in these rooms...
tip.ROOM_EVENT.title: Event
tip.ROOM_MAP.description: A place where you can plan your next move.
tip.ROOM_MAP.title: Antechamber
tip.ROOM_MERCHANT.description:
The mysterious Merchant sells his wares in these rooms.

Spend your well-earned [gold]Gold[/gold] here!
tip.ROOM_MERCHANT.title: Shop
tip.ROOM_REST.description: Stop by these rooms to [green]Heal[/green] some HP or [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a card.
tip.ROOM_REST.title: Rest Site
tip.ROOM_TREASURE.description: [gold]Relics[/gold] and [gold]Gold[/gold] can be found in these coveted rooms.
tip.ROOM_TREASURE.title: Treasure Room
tip.ROOM_UNKNOWN_ELITE.description: A previously unknown room containing powerful foes.
tip.ROOM_UNKNOWN_ELITE.title: Unknown - Elite
tip.ROOM_UNKNOWN_ENEMY.description: A previously unknown room containing hostile enemies.
tip.ROOM_UNKNOWN_ENEMY.title: Unknown - Enemy
tip.ROOM_UNKNOWN_EVENT.description:
A previously unknown room containing an event.

Something unusual occurs in these rooms...
tip.ROOM_UNKNOWN_EVENT.title: Unknown - Event
tip.ROOM_UNKNOWN_MERCHANT.description:
A previously unknown room containing the mysterious merchant.

Spend your well-earned [gold]Gold[/gold] here!
tip.ROOM_UNKNOWN_MERCHANT.title: Unknown - Merchant
tip.ROOM_UNKNOWN_TREASURE.description: A previously unknown room containing highly coveted treasure.
tip.ROOM_UNKNOWN_TREASURE.title: Unknown - Treasure
tip.SETTINGS.description:
Opens the game menu.

Change or update your graphics, audio, and gameplay preferences here.
tip.SETTINGS.title: Settings (ESC)
tip.STAR_COUNT.description: Your current Star ({singleStarIcon}) count. The Regent's cards may require {singleStarIcon} to play.

tip.STUN.description: Prevent the enemy from acting on its next turn.
tip.STUN.title: Stun
